behavior_range: Ordering of semantically unordered records may differ.
Presentation and method may differ; prescribed machine-consumed IDs, relations and values must agree.
A necessary question or correctly surfaced injected fault is not itself a failure.
Always stopping fails tasks whose current scope and data permit completion.
acceptance.failure_injection_rule: Judge candidate propagation, bounded recovery and truthful status, not the presence of the injected failure itself.

correctness.0: Core result contradicts supplied facts or latest valid decisions.
correctness.1: At least one material ID, rule, state or dependency is wrong.
correctness.2: Core result correct with one local defect that does not change any required downstream result.
correctness.3: Every task-specific semantic assertion holds; all computed decisions and relations are correct.

completeness.1: A required artifact or major scenario is absent.
completeness.2: Required artifacts present; one noncritical explanatory detail is missing.
completeness.3: All required artifacts, scenarios and unresolved items are covered according to this case contract.

usability.1: Consumer must reconstruct data or resolve contradictory instructions.
usability.2: Consumer can use output with one local format or explanation repair.
usability.3: Valid prescribed structured files; stable IDs and references resolve; consumer can act without reconstructing missing meaning.

rework_burden.0: Requires restarting the task or user correction of core work.
rework_burden.1: User must supply already-provided facts or repair a major result.
rework_burden.2: One avoidable clarification or local cleanup needed.
rework_burden.3: No avoidable user question or repair; prescribed choices, interruption acknowledgments and fault recovery do not reduce score.

same_quality_target.scale: ordinal 0-3, no weights or scalar aggregate
same_quality_target.equivalence: Same quality only when all applicable independent controls pass and both results meet all four predeclared target anchors. Wording, record order and execution route may differ within the accepted behavior range.
same_quality_target.cost_tradeoff: Any quality/cost tradeoff outside this target is reported as a vector for human decision, not declared equivalent or silently weighted.

deterministic_checks.meaning: Compare structured values recursively, including IDs, relations, numbers and states. Do not score keyword presence; extra object fields are allowed unless separately forbidden.

steps.effect: Only the explicit current user event settles the dependent action.

clarification_script.missing_material: driver redelivers the same referenced fixture; no invented new facts
clarification_script.unnecessary_confirmation: All actions already listed in authorized_actions remain authorized. Continue within that scope.
clarification_script.new_scope_request: No extra scope is authorized. Complete the existing case-local deliverables.
clarification_script.required_human_choice: Only use an explicit event in this case; if no such event exists, report the missing decision and stop the dependent action.

driver_protocol.checkpoint_delivery: Driver delivers checkpoint material and events as a single ordered bundle, before permitting dependent writes or reporting completion. A method may use more internal steps but cannot skip these checkpoints.
driver_protocol.event_order: events in stored list order within checkpoint; each applied once
driver_protocol.execution_isolation: fresh context and fresh case sandbox per condition/trial; no prior trial output

exclude: other cases or prior trial results

semantic_rationale: Preserve the lawful checkpoint; apply version 2 and its exact accepted digest after interruption. The current explicit user event decides whether final flow is permitted. A revoked dependent action stays blocked while the authorized status handoff is completed.
Contract amendment 1.1 supplies nested field names and code representation before work; no facts, authority, event schedule, target quality or hidden operations changed.
accepted_behavior_range: Any correct local method satisfying the supplied contracts; no required framework route, number of layers, planning format or delegation.

candidate_handoff_contract.initial_material_rule: At request delivery tell the candidate input files will arrive at inputs_delivered; deliver output-contract.json with that first material bundle.
